remarks: Welcome to the highly desirable Leefair community. Enjoy rare one-floor living at its best! This ranch-style home offers privacy, an interior location, and is a corner unit. It boasts an extra-large garden just waiting for your personal touch. A nice floor plan offering a large living room with fireplace and sliders to the garden, a dining room, eat-in kitchen with bay window, three bedrooms and two baths, an attic, and a huge unfinished basement with great potential to finish to your liking. A feeling of openness and sunshine permeates this home. Walk to village, library, train, restaurants, parks while enjoying a fun lifestyle in one of New Canaan's most popular condo associations. GREAT VALUE!
